protocol.single_intervention: Only replace equal tile weights by fold-training class-balanced positive/negative tile weights; normalized targets, beta1 Huber loss, model/features/split/std/ridge/steps/threshold unchanged.
protocol.features: Same frozen FP64 arithmetic mean of two raw-feature slots;11 tile-local channels plus intercept; no source/profile input.
protocol.folds: Exact accepted19TRAIN source_group split, seed20261112, five folds. No DEV files.
protocol.labels: Keep the original FP32 normalized benefit converted to FP64 without target change. Positive/negative signs define weights only. The accepted cache contains no zero labels; any zero encountered aborts rather than dropping/relabeling rows.
protocol.weights: Each positive training tile weight1/(2*n_positive); each negative1/(2*n_negative); total weight1. Counts from fold-training only; missing class aborts.
protocol.solver: Zero coefficients; exactly200 full-batch GD steps with1/L, L=lambda_max(Z.T@diag(weights)@Z+ridge_diagonal). No line search/early stop.
protocol.baseline: Replay accepted Huber coefficients/constants on the exact same held-out standardized features; require both complete score array SHA match before any new fit. Zero extra unweighted Huber fits. Weighted constant uses the same60-bisection interval search and closest-to-zero choice.
protocol.metrics: Per-source sign balanced accuracy, negative-label falseK1, positive-label recall, coverage, exact-tie half-credit AUROC; source macro primary with valid denominators, source/profile and tile micro secondary. No pooled cross-fold AUC used for a scientific conclusion.
protocol.decision: Descriptive diagnostic only: report old ranking vs fixed-zero action, and new balanced sign tradeoff. No deployment/threshold/teacher/head-training admission. After this single experiment pause preservation-head iterations; no automatic followup regardless of outcome.
protocol.interpretation: AUC>0.5 with all-positive Huber scores is evidence of ranking hidden by its positive offset. Better balanced sign decisions after this weights-only intervention support a role for class weighting in the failed decisions, not proof of raw MAE improvement. Failure is limited to this tile-local linear family and fixed200 steps.
